title: How refunds are processed
content: Refunds are typically issued to the original payment method. Processing times depend on the bank or card provider and may take 5 to 10 business days after approval.

title: Why a payment may fail
content: Payments can fail due to expired cards, insufficient funds, bank restrictions, or incorrect billing details. Customers should verify their payment information and try again.

title: Updating billing information
content: Customers can update their billing information from the account settings page. Changes to payment methods apply to future charges only.

title: Understanding duplicate charges
content: A duplicate charge may appear as a temporary authorization or as two separate transactions. Support should verify the transaction history before issuing a refund.

title: When invoices are generated
content: Invoices are generated at the time of successful payment. Customers can download invoice history from their billing section if that feature is enabled.

title: How to reschedule a reservation
content: Reservations can be rescheduled from the bookings page before the cutoff window. After the cutoff, changes may not be allowed depending on the venue policy.

title: Why a reservation was cancelled
content: Reservations may be cancelled automatically if the venue becomes unavailable, the booking violates policy, or required confirmation steps were not completed.

title: Reservation no-show policy
content: If a customer does not attend a reservation and does not cancel in time, the booking may be marked as a no-show and penalties may apply based on policy.

title: How to check reservation status
content: Customers can view reservation status in the bookings section. Common statuses include confirmed, pending, cancelled, completed, and no-show.

title: Late arrival for reservations
content: Some venues allow a short grace period for late arrivals. After that period, the reservation may be released or marked as missed according to venue rules.

title: Troubleshooting login issues
content: If a customer cannot log in, they should verify their email and password, reset the password if needed, and ensure the app is updated to the latest version.

title: App crashes during checkout
content: If the app crashes during checkout, customers should restart the app, clear cache if available, and retry on a stable network connection.

title: Verification email not received
content: Customers should check spam folders, confirm the email address is correct, and request a new verification email. Delivery delays may occur with some providers.

title: Trouble loading account data
content: If account data does not load, the issue may be caused by network instability or a temporary backend problem. Retrying after a short wait often resolves it.

title: Push notifications not working
content: Customers should confirm notification permissions are enabled on the device and that the app is allowed to run background services if required.

title: How to upgrade a subscription
content: Customers can upgrade from the subscription page. The new plan may take effect immediately or at the next billing cycle depending on the billing rules.

title: How to cancel auto-renewal
content: Auto-renewal can be turned off from subscription settings. Access usually remains active until the end of the current billing period.

title: Subscription benefits not visible
content: If benefits are missing, support should verify the subscription is active and correctly linked to the customer account before escalating the issue.

title: Paused versus cancelled subscriptions
content: A paused subscription is temporarily inactive and may resume later, while a cancelled subscription ends and does not renew unless purchased again.

title: Changing subscription plans
content: Customers may switch between eligible plans from the subscription management page. Pricing adjustments depend on the timing of the change.

title: How to contact support
content: Customers can contact support through the help center, in-app chat, or email depending on the support channels available for their account.

title: Updating profile information
content: Profile details such as name, phone number, and preferences can usually be updated from the account settings page.

title: Understanding account verification
content: Account verification helps confirm customer identity and may be required for security, payments, or access to certain features.

title: Where to find booking history
content: Customers can review past and upcoming bookings from the booking history or activity section of the app or website.

title: How account notifications work
content: Account notifications may include booking updates, billing alerts, and promotional messages. Notification preferences can often be customized.
